// Package badexample is a synthetic KNOWN-BAD fixture for
// qdrant_client_convergence_test.go's
// TestQdrantClientConstructedOnlyByNewQdrantClient. Scanned under the
// display path "internal/example/example_test.go", it stands in for a
// regression test that dials Qdrant directly through the plain (unaliased)
// qdrant import instead of store.NewQdrantClient — the exact bypass D-11
// exists to catch. Must scan dirty with exactly two findings, one per dial
// helper.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package badexample

import (
	"github.com/qdrant/go-client/qdrant"
)

func dialDirect(host string, port int) (*qdrant.Client, error) {
	return qdrant.NewClient(&qdrant.Config{Host: host, Port: port})
}

func dialGrpc(host string, port int) (*qdrant.GrpcClient, error) {
	return qdrant.NewGrpcClient(&qdrant.Config{Host: host, Port: port})
}
